objective.primary_goal: Create a premium, truthful, context-aware visual system for 144 Starlight agents without scaling any unapproved identity direction.
target_audience: founders and operators adopting governed agent teams
developers and architects designing multi-agent systems
objective.desired_first_read: Each agent is a distinctive, warm, clearly non-human specialist whose work, personality, handoff, and authority boundary are legible before lore.

scale_model.scaling_strategy: Invest generative craft in a legible signature cast and the founding specialists; give expansion drafts deterministic vector identities until their agent lifecycle evidence earns richer embodiment.

generated_master_tiers.label: Signature cast
generated_master_tiers.eligibility: Ten founding conductors plus Vera and Mira after a founder-approved application quartet.

generated_master_tiers.label: Founding specialists
generated_master_tiers.eligibility: The remaining rich founding cards after role, silhouette, workflow, and surface contracts pass.

generated_master_tiers.label: Shared world and workflow scenes
generated_master_tiers.eligibility: Reusable multi-agent handoff, supervision, evidence, and world scenes with deterministic interface overlays.

deterministic_export_programs.label: Agent master responsive exports
deterministic_export_programs.export_logic: Four exact crops by three responsive widths by AVIF and WebP; no generative recropping or baked interface text.

deterministic_export_programs.label: Shared scene responsive exports
deterministic_export_programs.export_logic: Three exact crops by two responsive widths by AVIF and WebP, with proof labels rendered as code.

deterministic_export_programs.label: Portfolio interface identity kit
deterministic_export_programs.export_logic: Three vector-first levels of detail by two themes by SVG and PNG; runtime state and permission glyphs remain separate structured overlays.

style_territories.label: Legacy cinematic sovereign
style_territories.purpose: Retain the strongest earlier Starlight recognition for selective hero, lore, and evolution moments.
style_territories.visual_signature: Dark porcelain and obsidian, restrained brass and cyan, sculptural depth, adult proportions, and one real role instrument.
avoid: cape or high heels as authority

style_territories.label: Civic intelligence editorial
style_territories.purpose: Make governed intelligence feel useful, public-minded, inspectable, humane, and institutionally credible.
style_territories.morphology_family: compact specialist, instrument, or bounded environment
style_territories.visual_signature: Tactile editorial craft, calm natural light, mineral and paper color, visible evidence artifacts, and accountable human context.

style_territories.label: Precision product character
style_territories.purpose: Give agent profiles and marketplace surfaces the credibility of a designed physical instrument.
style_territories.visual_signature: Neutral product-editorial staging, mechanically plausible seams, quiet material contrast, clean silhouette, and one serviceable tool.

style_territories.label: Academy compact guide
style_territories.purpose: Support learning and onboarding with original animation warmth while keeping capability and authority calibrated.
style_territories.visual_signature: Original feature-animation-informed proportions, authored machine construction, task-focused hands, readable learning tools, and expressive timing.

style_territories.label: Engineered biotech symbiote
style_territories.purpose: Express living-systems intelligence through functional biomimicry without fantasy, predation, or body horror.
style_territories.morphology_family: non-arachnid symbiote or bounded living environment
style_territories.visual_signature: Dry opaline membranes, ceramic load paths, biopolymer joints, clean scientific light, and one observable living-system function.

style_territories.label: Evidence instrument
style_territories.purpose: Turn verification, research, and provenance roles into function-first non-humanoid characters.
style_territories.morphology_family: lens, measure, press, archive, or relay instrument
style_territories.visual_signature: Readable input and output paths, calibrated optics, physical evidence handling, restrained motion, and no decorative face requirement.

style_territories.label: Architectural intelligence
style_territories.purpose: Represent agents that are rooms, thresholds, archives, studios, or other bounded intelligent environments.
style_territories.morphology_family: alcove, archive doorway, studio, or instrumented room
style_territories.visual_signature: Human-scale civic architecture, legible thresholds, material state changes, accessible wayfinding, and visible governance boundaries.

style_territories.label: Modular fabricator
style_territories.purpose: Visualize agents that build, transform, package, or maintain artifacts through mechanically credible reconfiguration.
style_territories.visual_signature: Visible kinematic logic, modular work surfaces, restrained industrial color, reversible states, and the artifact at the center.

style_territories.label: Creature companion
style_territories.purpose: Use non-humanoid social forms for bounded guidance, exploration, and return visits where relationship matters.
style_territories.morphology_family: book-carrying bird, soft quadruped, or articulated navigator
style_territories.visual_signature: Clearly mechanical creature anatomy, role-shaped carrying or pointing behavior, authored locomotion, and quiet relational presence.

style_territories.label: Micro interface identity
style_territories.purpose: Make agent identity, state, and role distinguishable in dense graphs, lists, notifications, and compact controls.
style_territories.visual_signature: One silhouette, one role cut, one color-independent state glyph, high contrast, exact geometry, and no simulated emotion.

face_systems.label: Twin micro aperture
face_systems.architecture: A narrow mechanical faceplate with two small recessed optical apertures.
face_systems.eye_logic: Direction communicates attention and intensity communicates machine activity, never emotion or authority.
face_systems.warmth_source: Patient head orientation, open posture, and measured response timing.

face_systems.label: Soft square attention
face_systems.architecture: Two compact soft-square apertures set behind a strong non-human brow shell.
face_systems.eye_logic: Subtle parallax and focus depth communicate joint attention without pupils or eyelids.
face_systems.warmth_source: Readable turn-taking, small head tilts, and competent hand behavior.

face_systems.label: Protective shutter
face_systems.architecture: Two recessed optics behind calm mechanical shutters and a broad protective plane.
face_systems.eye_logic: Shutters narrow only for focus or risk containment and never simulate anger.
face_systems.warmth_source: Protective stance, controlled distance, and visible de-escalation behavior.

face_systems.label: Directional sensor trench
face_systems.architecture: An eyeless vertical sensor recess integrated into a calibrated instrument head.
face_systems.eye_logic: A moving internal marker shows scan direction without pretending to express emotion.
face_systems.warmth_source: Careful pacing, transparent status, and an outward-facing evidence artifact.

face_systems.label: Opaline biotech aperture
face_systems.architecture: A dry translucent optical chamber seated in a ceramic and biopolymer shell.
face_systems.eye_logic: Internal polarization indicates sensing mode while external shape remains mechanically stable.
face_systems.warmth_source: Responsive body orientation and cooperative proximity rather than humanlike gaze.

face_systems.label: Restrained e-ink band
face_systems.architecture: A low-power monochrome strip embedded in a compact mechanical face shell.
face_systems.eye_logic: Aperture blocks and simple directional marks show attention, uncertainty, or pause without a cartoon face.
face_systems.warmth_source: Honest uncertainty signals, respectful spacing, and responsive task behavior.

face_systems.label: Primary and secondary optic
face_systems.architecture: One calibrated primary lens and one smaller contextual sensor in an asymmetric tool head.
face_systems.eye_logic: The primary follows the active object while the secondary tracks context and handoff readiness.
face_systems.warmth_source: Visible divided attention, careful reorientation, and explicit task completion.

face_systems.label: Monoscopic calibrated iris
face_systems.architecture: A single protected precision iris centered inside a clearly instrumental housing.
face_systems.eye_logic: Iris diameter encodes measurement range and never maps to emotional arousal.
face_systems.warmth_source: Stable distance, gentle movement, and transparent measurement handoffs.

face_systems.label: Faceted prism sensor
face_systems.architecture: A non-ocular refractive sensor assembled from a few durable mineral planes.
face_systems.eye_logic: Light separates by comparison mode and recombines when a synthesis is ready for review.
face_systems.warmth_source: Curious orientation, collaborative framing, and a visible comparison artifact.

face_systems.label: Environmental witness lights
face_systems.architecture: An eyeless room or threshold uses several fixed witness lights at human-readable locations.
face_systems.eye_logic: Location and rhythm show which zone is sensing, processing, waiting, or requesting review.
face_systems.warmth_source: Legible invitation, accessible thresholds, daylight, and human-scale spatial behavior.

surface_profiles.critical_read: Identity, silhouette, specialty instrument, and grounded posture survive without a caption.
One real workflow transformation is visible with negative space reserved for accessible HTML copy.
Maker, verifier, artifact, failure route, and human gate are separable before deterministic overlays.
The active agent and artifact remain clear inside a narrow one-handed storytelling crop.
Specialty and visual identity remain legible beside real structured package metadata.
Face architecture and one role cue remain distinguishable from every sibling agent.
Silhouette and state glyph survive while permission and confidence remain structured metadata.

batches.label: Foundation application quartet
batches.variable_under_test: one coherent design territory per candidate
exit_criteria: four exports inspected in exact contexts
founder selects, blends, or restarts the territory

batches.label: Signature cast wave
batches.variable_under_test: role-shaped embodiment inside one founder-approved family
entry_criteria: all twelve character contracts and silhouette proofs pass
exit_criteria: all masters score at least 26 of 30
human review approves every production-facing asset

batches.label: Founding specialist wave
batches.variable_under_test: specialty legibility with only identity and workflow masters
entry_criteria: signature cast establishes the shared design grammar
each specialist has an approved morphology and exact workflow
exit_criteria: desktop mobile marketplace and graph crops are inspected

batches.label: Shared world and workflow wave
batches.variable_under_test: reusable multi-agent handoff and governance scenes
entry_criteria: every scene maps to a real workflow and human gate
exit_criteria: all scenes pass operational truth review
generated interface text is replaced with exact code overlays

batches.label: Expansion vector identity kit
batches.variable_under_test: deterministic role-vessel geometry for draft expansion identities
entry_criteria: vector compiler and accessibility state grammar pass
exit_criteria: all expansion identities distinguish at 96 pixels
no visual implies authority or maturity absent from the card

batches.label: Deterministic surface exports
batches.variable_under_test: exact crop compression theme and accessible level-of-detail variants
entry_criteria: surface crop and vector specifications are locked
exit_criteria: desktop mobile graph and marketplace visual QA pass

evidence.current_production_baseline: Existing v1 Starlight portraits remain the continuity baseline; Phase E-I does not replace them.
